payload.title: Give procedure agents skills: load SKILL.md documents by reference
payload.description: A Tactus Agent gets a system_prompt string and tools; there is no way to hand it a skill document. Papyrus already has skills/newsroom-research-workflow/SKILL.md and the Humanus skill ships as humanus skill. Let a procedure (or an agent block) name skills, from Papyrus, from a site's repository or from the backend, and load them into the agent's instructions, so the same SKILL.md serves Claude Code interactively and the procedure's agent. First use: Distinctive's TTAB ruling-analysis skill.
